description: PSG Grant page sections, in the order they appear: hero, the PSG benefits band, everything included with Xero, the grant criteria, how to apply, InvoiceNow, our credentials, the Google Reviews slider, the FAQ and the final CTA. Only two blocks on this page are new to the theme — the ticked list beside a photograph (drawn twice, as the criteria and the InvoiceNow sections) and the two accreditation marks under the hero, which are theme artwork rather than fields. Everything else is a section another page already draws, so the three card grids are the same component with different values and their fields are grouped by section above. The testimonials_*, faq_* and cta_* field names repeat the other pages’ names under different keys, which is what lets template-parts/testimonials.php, faq.php and cta.php stay page-agnostic; unlike most pages, the questions here are this page’s own rather than the site-wide “FAQs” posts. Everything is flat fields because ACF free has no Repeater — quantities are fixed by the layout, and empty entries are skipped rather than rendered blank. Leave a field empty and the design’s own copy renders instead: because the theme treats an empty value as “use the design default”, a field that ships with copy cannot be blanked from here, only replaced.
